summary: Executed Iter65 targeted backend regression and frontend P0 smoke on public preview URL for i18n/nav/theme/chat/role-preview checks.

ui_bugs.issue: After switching language to EN, key system texts remain Indonesian (e.g., 'Perlu Perhatian Anda', 'Segarkan').

action_items: Investigate dev-time Babel plugin chain: verify ui-i18n plugin execution order/effective application under withVisualEdits (craco start path), especially for /src/pages/admin/Dashboard.jsx.
Confirm transformed output in preview runtime (not only catalog availability) and retest EN mode across admin dashboard/roles/labels/releases/payments/royalty pages.
Run remaining unexecuted P0 media/sound/chat multi-turn and WIB boundary-time assertions (05:59/06:00/17:59/18:00) after i18n compile issue is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints requested in scope are aligned: /api/admin/access/catalog and /api/admin/navigation both exclude label_rates; /api/chat/unread returns latest incoming fields; removed dangerous reset endpoint is no longer callable (404/405).
Translation catalog already contains EN mappings for failing dashboard strings, so runtime issue is not missing dictionary data.
Route guard for removed import tab is correct: /admin/labels/rate-import redirects to /admin/labels and no label_rates nav testid rendered.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (targeted smoke passed; major i18n regression found; several P0 deep scenarios pending)

context_for_next_testing_agent: UI automation confirmed login, nav/redirect/theme menu visibility, role preview modal, and mobile overflow/chat panel smoke. Repro issue: set EN via [data-testid='language-en-admin'] on /admin/dashboard then inspect [data-testid='admin-action-center'] still showing Indonesian labels. Screenshots captured via automation output folders and /app/test_reports/screenshots/iter65_ui*.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: login super admin -> /admin/dashboard -> switch EN from header language menu. Expected: Action Center text becomes English per catalog. Actual: key dashboard literals remain Indonesian. RCA evidence: (1) catalog.en.json includes mappings (Perlu Perhatian Anda, Segarkan, Ringkasan Platform), (2) language state toggles and some explicit translated UI parts do update, (3) behavior pattern matches missing/inactive Babel JSX system-text transformation in active preview compilation path (likely dev chain interaction around withVisualEdits/craco).
